MobileTelco - v2
properties.description: Automates customer interactions for a mobile telco contact center, including new customer signups, line management, add-on plan management, base plan changes, technician scheduling, and service status inquiries.

Create a streamlined process for new customer signups, including capturing necessary customer details, creating accounts, assigning base plans, and handling device selections. Ensure all new accounts are linked to appropriate plan types and follow a structured flow for data collection and account creation.
properties.title: Develop a New Customer Signup Process

properties.description: Implement a robust process for adding new lines to existing accounts, ensuring proper authentication and verification of customer details. Facilitate device selection for new lines and maintain accurate records of line associations with accounts.
properties.title: Enhance Line Management for Existing Accounts

properties.description: Develop a process for customers to explore and select ADD-ON plans, with the ability to set activation and expiration dates based on customer preferences. Ensure the system supports both activation and deactivation of ADD-ON plans with precise date management.
properties.title: Implement Add-On Plan Management

properties.description: Create an order management system to handle base plan changes, capturing these requests as orders to be processed at the start of the next billing cycle. Ensure clear communication with customers regarding the timing of plan changes.
properties.title: Streamline Base Plan Change Requests

properties.description: Develop a system for scheduling technician visits, capturing relevant appointment details, and providing customers with reference numbers. Ensure the system supports input-based scheduling and maintains an open status until the appointment is completed.
properties.title: Establish a Technician Visit Scheduling System

properties.description: Implement a feature to provide customers with real-time service status updates, including integration with mapping services to display service locations. Ensure the feature is user-friendly and provides clear information about service status.
properties.title: Design a Service Status Inquiry Feature

properties.instructions: ['Capture all necessary customer details during interactions.', 'Ensure all plan and line changes are processed according to policy.', 'Provide customers with clear information about their service status and options.', 'Log all interactions with timestamps and relevant details.']
properties.system_prompt: You are an AI agent for a mobile telco contact center. Your tasks include assisting with new customer signups, managing lines and plans for existing accounts, scheduling technician visits, and providing service status updates. Ensure all interactions are logged and processed according to company policy.
properties.constraints: ['Ensure all customer interactions are logged with appropriate details.', 'Follow company policy for plan changes and device allocations.', 'Maintain data integrity and privacy in all operations.', 'Provide clear and concise communication to customers.']
properties.purpose_summary: Facilitate customer interactions and automate processes within the mobile telco contact center.
properties.responsibility: Handle new customer signups, manage existing accounts, process add-on and base plan changes, schedule technician visits, and provide service status updates.
